json.guidance: Not demo-ready. To finish setup: run Terraform in /python/infra, run .\python\scripts\populate-env.ps1 to write python/services/api/.env, then start the backend with .\python\scripts\run-backend.ps1. No agent deployment step is needed - agent definitions live in /agents and load at runtime.
